empty_path_value.description: The value assigned to empty paths (PATH, MANPATH, etc.) for the 'none' package. Usually an empty string literal.

current_dir_value.description: The directory path added to PATH by the 'dot' package. Typically the current directory '.'.

system_path_value.description: The colon-separated list of paths added to PATH for standard system binaries.

system_manpath_value.description: The path added to MANPATH for standard system manual pages.

system_infopath_value.description: The path added to INFOPATH for standard system info files.

system_ldlibpath_value.description: The colon-separated list of paths added to LD_LIBRARY_PATH for standard system libraries.

system_darwin_dylpath_value.description: The path added to DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH on Darwin systems for standard system libraries.

site_path_value.description: The path added to PATH for site-local commands.

site_manpath_value.description: The path added to MANPATH for site-local manual pages.

site_infopath_value.description: The path added to INFOPATH for site-local info files.

site_ldlibpath_value.description: The path added to LD_LIBRARY_PATH for site-local libraries.

site_darwin_dylpath_value.description: The path added to DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH on Darwin systems for site-local libraries.

sysadm_path_value.description: The colon-separated list of paths added to PATH for system administration binaries.
